_comment: Hand-maintained price table for projecting what a live-cert run would cost
BEFORE it is authorised. Read tools/cost-project's own doc comment for the
rules this file is under; the two that matter most:
1. A type that is absent is UNPRICED, never free. tools/cost-project
reports unpriced types by name and refuses to present its total as
complete while any remain. Adding an entry with free:true is a
deliberate statement that the resource carries no charge; leaving it
out is a statement that nobody has checked.
2. monthly_usd carries prorated: a Route 53 hosted zone is billed for the
whole month even if it lives for an hour, while a KMS key is prorated.
Getting that wrong understates a short run by orders of magnitude.
Prices are on-demand list, us-east-1, and every entry names where it came
from. They are a projection, not a quote, and they exclude data transfer,
request charges and storage unless an entry says otherwise.

aws_iam_role.note: IAM principals and policies carry no charge

aws_internet_gateway.note: the gateway is free; data transfer is not modelled

aws_sqs_queue.note: first 1M requests/month free; a queue at rest is free

aws_sns_topic.note: a topic at rest is free; publishes are not modelled

aws_cloudwatch_log_group.note: free empty; ingestion and storage are not modelled

aws_dynamodb_table.note: PAY_PER_REQUEST with no data and no traffic

aws_ecs_service.note: free at desired_count 0; running Fargate tasks are NOT modelled

aws_s3_bucket.note: free empty; storage and requests are not modelled

aws_lambda_function.note: free at rest; invocations are not modelled

aws_route53_zone.note: billed for the whole month even if deleted within it

aws_route53_record.note: standard records are free; queries are not modelled

aws_nat_gateway.note: plus $0.045 per GB processed, not modelled

aws_vpc_endpoint.note: interface endpoint, per AZ; gateway endpoints are free

aws_eip.note: charged whether associated or not since 2024

aws_lb.note: ALB; plus LCU charges, not modelled

aws_instance.note: t3.micro on-demand; LARGER TYPES COST MORE and this table does not read the instance_type

aws_db_instance.note: db.t3.micro single-AZ; larger classes and storage are not modelled

aws_cloudfront_distribution.note: no hourly charge; requests and transfer are not modelled

aws_ebs_volume.note: gp3 per GB-month; this table assumes 1 GB and does NOT read size
